emma: quick concept: add a left-rail "Invoices" panel that can be pinned open on desktop and collapses on mobile. gives a persistent entrypoint without stuffing the header. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/left-rail-invoices li: +1 for discoverability. downside: eats horizontal space in cramped layouts. idea: desktop left-rail + mobile FAB (floating action button) bottom-right that opens same panel. noah: finance asks: per-project download is still critical. proposal: keep a subtle per-row PDF icon (secondary) and the left-rail for bulk and status. per-row icon visible for top N projects, else inside kebab. lia: accessibility nits: pinned panel must have aria-expanded on the toggle, keyboard focus order should move into the panel when opened, and it should trap focus if it acts like a dialog. if it's a region, ensure role="region" and aria-label="Invoices". exports should use an aria-live region to announce "Export started" and "Export completed". also non-color encoding for invoice status badges. emma: A/B experiment idea: Variant A = Left-rail + per-row icon; Variant B = Header Export (primary) + per-row in kebab only. Metrics: time-to-download (task completion), per-row vs bulk export ratio, support tickets saying "can't find invoice", keyboard-only completion rate. run 14 days. li: copy nit: call the rail "Invoices & exports" vs plain "Invoices"? I prefer short: "Invoices". also tooltip for cost: show tiny helper "$0.0008 / token (avg)" on hover in token card. noah: small UX: show invoice status pill (Paid / Pending / Processing) next to download to reduce accidental downloads of pending exports. add a hover tooltip explaining status. lia: snippet for row download a11y: and aria-live example:
Export started for 3 invoices...
figma-bot: Uploaded: frame "Left-rail invoices (desktop/mobile)". prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/left-rail emma: action items: 1) li prototype left-rail + FAB mobile (due Tue) 2) noah implement per-row visibility rule mock (top N) 3) lia run keyboard + screen-reader passes on prototype. we'll decide after experiment. :thumbsup:
